title: Workpiece State Engine + Geometry Input Layer
description: Build the WorkpieceStateEngine that tracks material removal step-by-step through the operation sequence. Create 3-level geometry input: Level 3 (Fusion B-rep via LiveBridge), Level 2 (feature-based AABB subtraction), Level 1 (G-code stock reconstruction). This engine is the foundation — every other feasibility check queries the evolving workpiece state.

units.title: WorkpieceStateEngine: IPW tracking with surface catalog and wall thickness detection
steps: Define WorkpieceState type: stock geometry, operations_applied, current_ipw, surfaces[], wall_sections[], volume_removed_pct
initialize(): set stock from bounding box, feature list, or B-rep reference
applyOperation(): subtract material for one operation, update IPW, recalculate surfaces and walls
getState(afterOp): return snapshot at any point in sequence
getSurfaces(): catalog all remaining surfaces with area, normal, position, flatness
getMinWallThickness(): scan IPW for thinnest wall section using cross-section analysis
rollback(toOp): undo operations for alternate sequence testing
Level 2 geometry: AABB constructive subtraction (stock - operation bounding boxes)
Track clamping zones: top, bottom, side1, side2, bore — area and accessibility
Track datum surfaces: which reference surfaces are still intact
exit_conditions: IPW updates correctly after each operation
Surface catalog accurate after material removal
Wall thickness detection finds minimum section

units.title: Geometry input adapters: Fusion B-rep, feature-based, G-code reconstruction
steps: Level 3 adapter: Fusion360LiveBridgeEngine geometry endpoint → extract faces, edges, volumes
Level 2 adapter: PartGeometryPipelineEngine features → AABB representation
Level 1 adapter: G-code parser → SweptVolumeEngine → reconstructed stock removal
Auto-detect available fidelity level and use highest available
Graceful degradation: if Fusion unavailable, fall back to Level 2; if no features, Level 1
exit_conditions: All 3 geometry levels produce compatible WorkpieceState
